claims.text: Role in Osgood-Schlatter: ice and NSAIDs for pain relief.
claims.quote: Local application of ice and NSAIDs can be used for pain relief.

claims.text: Peds dose: Ibuprofen 5–10 mg/kg PO q6–8h; max 400 mg/dose or 40 mg/kg/day.
claims.quote: Pediatric patients: The recommended dose of ibuprofen is 5-10 mg/kg orally every 6-8 hours, with a maximum of 400 mg per dose or 40 mg/kg daily.
Ibuprofen produced an elevation of plasma lithium levels and a reduction in renal lithium clearance
Thus, when ibuprofen and lithium are administered concurrently, subjects should be observed carefully for signs of lithium toxicity.
This may indicate that they could enhance the toxicity of methotrexate.

claims.text: Ibuprofen CI: asthma, urticaria or allergic-type rxns after ASA or other NSAIDs.
claims.quote: Ibuprofen tablets should not be given to patients who have experienced asthma, urticarial, or allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs.
